subject: general
question: The Red Panda eats _____ leaves.
solution:
The correct answer is __**bamboo**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bamboo** is the primary diet of the Red Panda.
 
• Red Pandas are native to the eastern Himalayas and southwestern China.
 
• They are classified as endangered due to habitat loss and fragmentation.
 
• Besides bamboo, Red Pandas may also eat fruits, acorns, roots, and eggs.
 
• Conservation efforts are crucial to protect the Red Panda's natural habitat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Red Panda** is also known as the lesser panda, the red bear-cat, and the red cat-bear.
 
• They have a specialized wrist bone that acts as a thumb, helping them grasp bamboo stalks.
 
• Red Pandas are solitary creatures and are most active during the dawn and dusk hours.
 
• They have a lifespan of about 8-10 years in the wild and up to 15 years in captivity.
 
• International organizations like the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) are actively involved in Red Panda conservation.
